newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Jerneh debuts at 6.00 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Jerneh debuts at 6.00 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian general insurance company Jerneh made their market debut on Monday at 6.00 ringgit against an offer price of 2.60 ringgit.
The company offered 11.595 million shares for its listing on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
About three minutes after the market opened the stock was at 5.85 ringgit on volume of 356,000 shares.
Brokers estimated the stock's fair value at around 6.00 ringgit.
The company forecast net earnings per share of 23.7 cents for the year ended December 31, 1996.
At 6.00 ringgit, its price earnings ratio is 25.3 times.
